start: Admin app, AI Assistant, credits at the top

steps.action: Open the credits sheet; leave "Members can get AI answers" on and set the monthly limit to 30 credits; save
user_sees: The switch on, the limit 30, and this month: answers and credits used
must_not: Owner or staff questions shown as using credits
The limit saved for another gym

steps.action: Look at the admin app bell
user_sees: One alert: "Members have used this month's AI answers. Until 1 Dec, they get help pages instead. To give them more, open AI Assistant and tap your credits at the top."
must_not: The same alert again for the next member this month
An alert when the owner set the limit to 0
A blank page

steps.action: Type a limit of 501 (over the most) and save
must_not: 501 saved
The switch flipped by the failed save

steps.action: A desk person opens the same call
must_not: The desk changing the members limit

steps.action: Turn "Members can get AI answers" off and save
must_not: Members still getting AI answers

user_sees: Members get AI answers again; used count unchanged
must_not: This month count reset by the switch

user_sees: Counts only: answers and credits this month
must_not: Member names or question words shown in the counts

start: Member app, gym help, the gym switch on and credits left

steps.action: Ask a question in the help box
must_not: Any word about credits shown to the member
Another member question counted

start: Member app, the owner switched AI answers off (or the month limit is reached, or the day limit)

user_sees: An answer from the help pages instead
must_not: An error
A credit taken
Words telling the member about the gym credits

start: Member asked a question and the AI did not answer

steps.action: The app reports the failed answer
must_not: The member day count used up by a failed answer
A slot given back twice

user_sees: An answer for the member only
must_not: The question words shown to the owner in the counts
Credit words shown to the member
